From: facilities@acme-corp.com
To: alex.rivera@acme-corp.com
Subject: HVAC maintenance — building B, floor 3
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700

Hi Alex,

Reminder that the HVAC units on building B floor 3 will be offline
Saturday Oct 17 from 6am to 2pm for filter replacement. The west wing
will lose cooling; the east wing stays on.

If the lab freezers on that floor are affected, move samples to the
floor 2 units by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
R. Osei — Facilities

**Summary:**  
Facilities is scheduling HVAC maintenance for **building B, floor 3** on **Saturday, Oct 17 from 6:00am to 2:00pm**. During that time, the **west wing will lose cooling** while the **east wing will remain on**. If any **lab freezers** on that floor could be affected, samples should be moved to the **floor 2 units by Friday EOD**.

**Action needed from you:**  
**Yes — potentially.** If you’re responsible for anything on that floor, especially lab freezers or samples, you should make sure they’re moved by **Friday end of day**. If not, no direct action is needed.
